text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 301, March 12, 1971 ]
FURTHER AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 155 DATED OCTOBER 28, 1968, AS AMENDED
BY EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 288 DATED FEBRUARY 6, 1971, WHICH CREATED THE GOMEZ,
BURGOS, ZAMORA CENTENNIAL COMMISSION
Executive Order No. 155 dated October 28, 1968, as amended by Executive Order No. 288 dated February 6,
1971, is further amended by reconstituting the Gomez, Burgos, Zamora Centennial Commission as follows:
“Justice Calixto Zaldivar
Hon. Onofre Corpuz
Vice-Chairman
Dr. Horacio de la Costa
Mr. Jose P. Apostol
Mrs. Carmen Guerrero Nakpil
Mr. Serafin D. Quiason
Mr. Carlos Quirino
Hon. Jose J. Roy
Hon. Leonides S. Virata
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
